title: Retargeting Ads: Why and How You Should Be Doing it (and Tools to Help)

facts.fact: First-time website visitors generally max out at a 3% conversion rate, according to a Business Insider e-commerce report cited by the page.
facts.quote: With first-time website visitors generally maxing out at a [3% conversion rate](http://www.businessinsider.com/e-commerce-report-shows-returning-customers-are-more-valuable-than-new-ones-2016-3)

facts.fact: Retargeting is considered most valuable for established brands whose websites get at least 100 unique visitors a month.
facts.quote: it’s most valuable for established brands whose websites get at least 100 unique visitors a month

facts.fact: About 70% of the audience who view retargeted ads convert, according to FinancesOnline statistics cited by the page.
facts.quote: about 70% of your audience who view your[retargeted ads convert](https://financesonline.com/retargeting-statistics/)

facts.fact: AdTriba's rule of thumb is to allocate around 20% of overall ad budget to retargeting and 80% to prospecting.
facts.quote: allocate around 20% of your overall ad budget to retargeting and 80% to prospecting

facts.fact: Retargeting works by placing a tracking pixel (code) on a website that tracks user behavior so businesses can show ads to users who already visited the site.
facts.quote: This is done by placing a piece of code, called a pixel, on your website that tracks users’ behavior.

facts.fact: Retargeting shows ads to previous website visitors, while remarketing means collecting contact information from prospects to send outbound marketing campaigns.
facts.quote: Retargeting is an advertising strategy that refers to showing ads to previous website visitors while remarketing is the act of collecting contact information

facts.fact: AdRoll describes itself as the #1 retargeting tool on the market, with over a decade of experience and many thousands of users.
facts.value: over a decade; many thousands of users
facts.quote: [AdRoll](https://www.adroll.com/) is the #1 retargeting tool on the market, with over a decade of experience and many thousands of users.

facts.fact: LinkedIn reports 675 million users each month, per the page.
facts.quote: With 675 million users each month, [LinkedIn](https://business.linkedin.com/marketing-solutions/ad-targeting/retargeting) has become one of the largest

facts.fact: Facebook is described on the page as the third most visited website on the Internet.
facts.quote: [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/business/goals/retargeting) is the third most visited website on the Internet

facts.fact: Facebook's Custom Audiences tool lets advertisers retarget any Facebook user who has interacted with their business, including on pages where the required pixel is added.
facts.quote: which enables you to retarget any Facebook user who’s interacted with your business — both on your Facebook page and outside the platform, on any website where you’ve added the required pixel.

facts.fact: LinkedIn's retargeting is described as a pay-per-click model, meaning advertisers pay only if retargeting ads are successful, per the page.
facts.quote: Plus, it’s a pay-per-click (PPC) model, which means you’ll only pay if your retargeting ads are successful.

facts.fact: SharpSpring Ads (formerly Perfect Audience) places retargeting ads across the wider Internet and on social platforms such as Facebook and Twitter, per the page.
facts.quote: they place ads across the wider Internet, in banners and sidebars, but they also cover social media platforms like Facebook and Twitter

facts.fact: Spotify uses retargeting ads to encourage freemium users to upgrade to premium packages, with the introductory premium price offered at a discount.
facts.quote: uses retargeting ads to encourage freemium users to upgrade to the pro packages. Customers will likely take this offer because the introductory price to the premium packages comes with a discount.

facts.fact: Expedia retargeted users who searched for flights but did not book them, offering discounts on airfare and hotel rates, which the page says significantly increased bookings.
facts.quote: specifically targeting those who had searched for flights but did not book them. The ads offer discounts on airfare and hotel rates, which significantly increased bookings for the company.

facts.fact: Google Ads' built-in retargeting lets businesses target users across Google platforms including Search, YouTube, Chrome, and Android phones.
facts.quote: which enables businesses to target users of any Google platform, including, of course, the search engine but also YouTube, Chrome, and Android phones.
